summary: New in Update 17.0. A cow-boom civ: Highland Cattle on berries feed the TC so almost no villagers farm, and Beasty calls it made for 2 TC. Stone of Destiny is the Feudal landmark pros prefer; Beasty's build guide goes Horsemen and Highland Archers off it, and Men-at-Arms and Pikemen are the strong infantry. Beasty rates them behind Vikings and harder to play.
openings: Beasty's Stone of Destiny build: Tower House behind the berries, 3 on gold to pay for cows (each is about three quarters of a villager of food), up to 9 cows, 4 villagers build the Stone at 3:20, Feudal around 5:00.

Off the Stone, Beasty builds a Stable and Archery Range in its range for the gold rebate, two Kirkman Fishponds, then a 2nd Stable and Range and a Mustering Hall; he raids at 9:00 with about 9 Horsemen and 12 Highland Archers.
Swaggy's Stone of Destiny variant goes Kirkmen and infantry instead, with Fishponds for gold.
Cows make 2 TC possible with almost no villagers on food (Beasty).
Abbey of the Isles Men-at-Arms all-in: Beasty lost with it and calls it weak in 1v1, maybe fine in team games.

spikes.label: Armored Men-at-Arms and Pikemen
spikes.detail: Beasty calls Feudal Men-at-Arms armor broken, and Scots Pikemen have extra armor and attack in 2 to 3 ranks; they beat his knights.
spikes.answer: Don't send knights or archers into them head-on; use your own heavy infantry or crossbows.

spikes.label: 9:00 Horseman and archer raid
spikes.detail: Beasty's build runs 2 Stables and 2 Ranges off a cow economy and leaves with about 9 Horsemen and 12 Highland Archers at 9:00, with a Mustering Hall behind it.
spikes.answer: Spearmen and a tower at each resource, wall the wood line, and hit their cows on the berries while their army is out.

spikes.label: Cow boom
spikes.detail: Each Highland Cattle is close to a villager of food, and Fishponds add about 40 gold a minute.
spikes.answer: Tower rush, or tower plus barracks, before the boom pays off (Beasty), and kill cows on the berries.

spikes.label: Mustering Hall and Gallowglass
spikes.detail: Musters drop whole squads at once and get cheaper with more military buildings nearby. Gallowglass deal area damage and brace against cavalry.
spikes.answer: Count their food bank and military buildings, not just the army you see; ranged units and siege against Gallowglass.

spikes.label: Men-at-Arms + handcannons
spikes.detail: Beasty's main Scots style ends in Men-at-Arms with Tacksmen; Imperial Men-at-Arms have 4 ranged armor and shred archers.
spikes.answer: Armored infantry, siege and cavalry that dodge the handcannons.

scout: Tower House on gold and cows on berries is the normal start
Stone of Destiny means eco; Abbey of the Isles means a Men-at-Arms all-in
A Stable and Archery Range beside the Stone: Beasty's Horseman and archer raid around 9:00
Stone villagers or a 2nd TC: the cow-boom 2 TC
A Mustering Hall and how many military buildings sit near it

pairings.why: Beasty's build guide: Horsemen raid and kill archers while Highland Archers hit harder than normal archers.
Beasty's main comp: armored front line with archers that hit frontlines harder (shorter range, more damage).
Heavily armored infantry wall that beats cavalry.
Swaggy's raiding: fast Caterans hit villagers while archers hold home.

winConditions.detail: Cow and Fishpond boom, often into 2 TC.
Tower Houses and repairable Keeps make them hard to raid.

howToBeat: Tower rush, or at least a tower plus barracks, to stop the cow boom (Beasty).
An early spear opening punishes their scouts and cows; cows on the berries are their food.
Against the Horseman and archer build, spearmen behind towers hold the 9:00 raid; then hit the cows on the berries while their army is away.
Out-range Highland Archers: they have 4.5 range and lose archer duels.
Mass armored infantry beats their melee and archer army (Beasty's Vikings won this way).
Don't trade knights into their Pikemen and Men-at-Arms.
